title: "Manage and Respond to Organizer Inquiries on HiiFest"
sidebarTitle: "Manage Inquiries"
description: "Learn how to view, respond to, and negotiate organizer inquiries on HiiFest — and how to get paid securely once a deal is agreed."
---

When an event organizer discovers your listing and wants to hire you, they send you an inquiry through HiiFest. Managing your inquiries promptly and professionally is the key to winning jobs and building a strong reputation on the platform. This guide walks you through finding your inquiries, responding effectively, and moving from initial contact to completed booking.

## Find Your Inquiries

All incoming inquiries appear in your vendor dashboard:

1. Log in at [platform.hiifest.app](https://platform.hiifest.app).
2. Go to your **Vendor Dashboard**.
3. Click **Inquiries** in the left sidebar.

Each inquiry shows the organizer's name, the event details they've shared (date, location, type), the service they're requesting, and the timestamp of the inquiry.

## Inquiry Statuses

Track every inquiry through its lifecycle with the following status labels:

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Pending" icon="clock">
    A new inquiry has arrived and is waiting for your response.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Accepted" icon="circle-check">
    You have accepted the inquiry and agreed to provide the service.
  </Card>
  <Card title="In Progress" icon="spinner">
    The event preparation is underway or the service is actively being delivered.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Completed" icon="flag-checkered">
    The service has been delivered and the booking is closed.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Declined" icon="circle-xmark">
    You or the organizer declined the inquiry.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## Respond to an Inquiry

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the inquiry">
    In your **Inquiries** list, click on a **Pending** inquiry to open the full thread. Read the organizer's message and review the event details they've provided — date, venue, expected audience size, and any specific requirements.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Choose your response type">
    You have three options for responding:

    - **Accept** — confirm that you can deliver the service as described and agree to the terms.
    - **Send a custom quote** — reply with a tailored proposal including your pricing, scope, and any conditions (see negotiating terms below).
    - **Decline** — let the organizer know you're unavailable or unable to fulfil the request. Always include a brief, polite reason — it maintains your professional reputation on the platform.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Write your response">
    Click **Reply** to open the message composer. Write a clear, professional response that addresses the organizer's specific requirements. If you're sending a custom quote, attach your pricing breakdown using the **Quote** tool in the composer.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Send and await confirmation">
    Click **Send**. The organizer receives a notification immediately. Most organizers reply within 24–48 hours. Monitor your inquiry thread for their response.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Confirm the booking">
    Once both parties agree on scope, price, and terms, click **Confirm Booking** to move the inquiry to **Accepted** status. HiiFest logs the agreed terms in the inquiry thread for reference.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Negotiate Terms

If the organizer's initial request doesn't quite match your standard offering, use the messaging thread to negotiate:

- **Scope adjustments** — propose changes to the service scope (e.g. number of hours, equipment quantity) to fit the budget or requirements.
- **Pricing** — counter with a revised quote and explain what's included at that price point.
- **Timeline** — clarify setup and breakdown times, rehearsal slots, or delivery deadlines.
- **Logistics** — confirm travel, accommodation (if applicable), and on-site access requirements.

Keep all negotiations inside the HiiFest inquiry thread so both parties have a clear record of what was agreed.

<Info>
  Organizers on the **Pro+** plan have access to a dedicated **Collaboration Workspace** — a shared project board where you and the organizer can manage tasks, share files, and track deliverables together. If your organizer is on Pro+, you'll see a **Workspace** tab appear inside the confirmed inquiry thread.
</Info>

## Getting Paid

Once a booking is confirmed, payment is processed through the HiiFest secure payment system:

- **Standard bookings** — the organizer pays through HiiFest at the agreed time (typically a deposit upfront with the balance due after the event).
- **Pro+ organizers with payment milestones** — organizers on the Pro+ plan can structure payment into multiple milestone installments (for example, 30% on booking confirmation, 40% one week before the event, 30% after delivery). You receive each milestone payment automatically when the organizer approves that phase.

<Note>
  All payments on HiiFest are held securely and released to your vendor account according to the agreed schedule. Make sure your payout bank account is set up in **Dashboard → Payment Settings** before accepting your first booking so there are no delays.
</Note>
